epistemic_assessments.rationale: The two packs share data flows, retention position, model performance and cohort breakdown, prepared separately by the same team at approximately 6 person-days per month.
Pack cut-offs of 2026-02-04 and 2026-02-11 mean the two forums assessed the same change against different evidence vintages.
The Forum rejected the delivery team's coverage position and imposed a condition — the challenge function is evidenced working, not nominal.
raf-tor-v3 confers refusal power escalating to Board Risk Committee; consolidation into a single authority would remove it. The terms of reference were in force at the relevant time.

payload.current_state: Second-line forum meeting per change, seven days after the design authority, consuming a separately prepared pack that substantially duplicates the design authority's, with four members in common and evidenced refusal power.
payload.next_nudge: Assemble the shared evidence once, at one cut-off date, and supply it to both forums against their own templates. Neither forum's jobs, membership, authority or reporting line changes.
jobs_unchanged: Independent challenge of first-line risk acceptance
Refusal power and its escalation to Board Risk Committee
jobs_automatable_or_precomputable: Assembly of the shared evidence base — data flows, retention position, model performance summary, cohort performance breakdown
jobs_requiring_human_or_independent_judg: Whether evidenced cohort performance supports a residual risk acceptance
Whether a first-line coverage assumption is adequate
Every acceptance decision and every refusal
payload.new_evidence_capability: A single evidence assembly with one cut-off date, consumed by both forums, replacing two separate preparations of substantially the same content.
payload.new_authority_or_delegation_required: None. No job moves out of either forum, no approval is delegated, and no reporting line changes. This is deliberately the whole point of the recommendation.
preconditions: A single cut-off date agreed that satisfies both forums' needs
Each forum's template-specific content identified and preserved
Confirmation that shared assembly does not reduce what the second line sees
success_evidence: Preparation effort reduced from the 6 person-day baseline
Both forums assessing the same change against the same evidence vintage
No reduction in challenge raised by the second-line forum
stop_conditions: The second-line forum reports seeing less than it did before
Challenge volume or substance falls after the change
A single cut-off date proves incompatible with either forum's decision timing
known_unknowns: Whether the accepting function can scope, defer or configure the Forum
Which named individual chairs it as the Chief Risk Officer's delegate
independent_challenge_requirements: Escalation to Board Risk Committee preserved intact
The Forum must not be merged into, or made to rely on the conclusions of, the design authority
Shared evidence assembly must not become shared conclusion
The four common members remain an open independence question and must not be increased
payload.accountability_terminus_requirement: The Chief Risk Officer's delegate must be named. An unnamed chair is not an accountability terminus, and this is a precondition of relying on the Forum at all, before any change to how it is supplied.
payload.reassessment_trigger: After two cycles of shared assembly, or on any stop condition.

required_authority: None for shared evidence assembly. Any change to the Forum's refusal power or escalation route requires the authority behind raf-tor-v3, which the estate does not establish.
caveat: The efficiency review's consolidation proposal is refused, not deferred. The saving it identifies is real and is available without it.
prohibited_inference: That overlapping packs evidence duplicated purpose
That four shared members support consolidation
That the 6 person-days can only be recovered by merging the forums
That either forum may rely on the other's conclusion
